commands.name: review-pr
commands.description: Comprehensive PR review using specialized agents (code-reviewer, comment-analyzer, pr-test-analyzer, silent-failure-hunter, type-design-analyzer, code-simplifier). Use for a multi-agent PR review pass; for the adversarially-verified Workflow pass use /orch-review, and for the standalone step-by-step checklist review use /code-review.

commands.name: rust-build
commands.description: Fix Rust build errors, borrow checker issues, and dependency problems incrementally. Invokes the rust-build-resolver agent for minimal, surgical fixes.

commands.name: rust-review
commands.description: Comprehensive Rust code review for ownership, lifetimes, error handling, unsafe usage, and idiomatic patterns. Invokes the rust-reviewer agent.

commands.name: rust-test
commands.description: Enforce TDD workflow for Rust. Write tests first, then implement. Verify 80%+ coverage with cargo-llvm-cov.

commands.name: santa-loop
commands.description: Adversarial dual-review convergence loop — two independent model reviewers must both approve before code ships. Use for the CLI-driven version of this loop; wraps the santa-method skill.

commands.name: save-session
commands.description: Save current session state to a dated file in ~/.claude/session-data/ so work can be resumed in a future session with full context.

commands.name: security-scan
commands.description: Run AgentShield against agent, hook, MCP, permission, and secret surfaces. This is the slash-command entrypoint for that audit; prefer the security-scan skill for the same AgentShield audit in conversation.

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: Manage Claude Code session history, aliases, and session metadata.

commands.name: setup-pm
commands.description: Configure your preferred package manager (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun)

commands.name: skill-create
commands.description: Analyze local git history to extract coding patterns and generate SKILL.md files. Local version of the Skill Creator GitHub App. Use to generate new skills from local git history on demand; check the skill-scout skill first to avoid duplicating an existing local, marketplace, or GitHub skill.

commands.name: skill-health
commands.description: Show skill portfolio health dashboard with charts and analytics. Use for the quantitative usage/success-rate dashboard; for a qualitative compliance or quality audit use the skill-stocktake skill.

commands.name: skill-host-compat
commands.description: Lint ECC skills for Codex/Cursor-safe frontmatter and Claude-only substitutions before a skill PR.

commands.name: test-coverage
commands.description: Analyze coverage, identify gaps, and generate missing tests toward the target threshold.

commands.name: token-card
commands.description: Render a token-usage stat card from local agent session logs and commit it to the repo. Invokes the token-card skill.

commands.name: update-codemaps
commands.description: Scan project structure and generate token-lean architecture codemaps.

commands.name: update-docs
commands.description: Sync documentation from source-of-truth files such as scripts, schemas, routes, and exports.

commands.name: vue-review
commands.description: Comprehensive Vue.js code review for Composition API correctness, reactivity, composable patterns, template security, accessibility, and Vue-specific performance. Invokes the vue-reviewer agent (and typescript-reviewer alongside on .vue/.ts changes).

commands.name: design-plan
commands.description: Generate a concrete design system (tokens, style, type, UX) before building UI

commands.name: design-review
commands.description: Run the 7-phase design review (WCAG AA, responsive, interaction) on a page or URL
